UserDisciplineProfile.title: UserDisciplineProfile
UserDisciplineProfile.description: Authenticated user's discipline state, sovereignty index, restrictions, and WhatsApp witness.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

timeDebtMinutes.description: Accumulated penalty time debt in minutes.

sealedContractDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date when today's contract was sealed.

restrictedMode.description: Optional flag indicating active restrictions due to missing photo proof.

witnessName.description: Optional designated WhatsApp accountability partner name.

witnessPhone.description: Optional designated WhatsApp phone number with country code.

autoWhatsApp.description: Optional flag to launch WhatsApp automatically on photo proof.

QaydTask.title: QaydTask
QaydTask.description: A mandatory sequential execution task requiring photo proof by a specific target time.

contractDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of the daily contract.

targetTimeLabel.description: Target completion time label chosen by user (e.g. 14:30).

deadlineEpochMs.description: Deadline epoch milliseconds once activated (0 before activation).

proofSummary.description: Optional execution proof caption or breach reason.

proofPhotoUri.description: Optional persisted local path/URI of the proof photo.

debtPenaltyMinutes.description: Overdue or breach penalty minutes applied.

recoveryTask.description: Whether this task is a mandatory penalty recovery task.

penaltyApplied.description: Whether automatic timeout punishment has already been recorded.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: Append-only immutable audit log of contracts, photo-verified completions, and punishments.

taskId.description: Related task ID or contract marker.

proofNote.description: Recorded photo caption or punishment justification.

proofPhotoUri.description: Optional persisted local path/URI of the proof photo.

/users/{userId}.description: User discipline profile, WhatsApp witness, and restriction state.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Mandatory sequential daily tasks with target time, photo proof, and punishment flag.

/users/{userId}/ledger/{entryId}.description: Immutable audit ledger of photo proofs and automatic punishments.
